summary: Second iteration testing of SULTAN app with new features. Backend APIs 100% functional (19/19 tests passed). All new features tested: Live gold prices from Gold-API.com, Prayer times from Aladhan API, Forgot password with OTP flow, Avatar upload, Community tab. live_gold_prices.details: Gold prices now fetched LIVE from Gold-API.com. Source field shows 'Gold-API.com (Live)'. Dashboard displays EGP 3,325 for 21K gold with 0.8% daily change. API endpoint /api/gold/prices returns prices for 18K, 21K, and 24K gold.

prayer_times.details: Prayer times fetched from Aladhan API. All 5 prayers returned: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha. API endpoint /api/prayer-times accepts city and country parameters (tested with Cairo, Egypt).

forgot_password.details: Complete forgot password flow working: 1) POST /api/auth/forgot-password sends 6-digit OTP (logged in backend + returned as dev_otp), 2) POST /api/auth/verify-otp validates OTP, 3) POST /api/auth/reset-password resets password, 4) User can login with new password. Frontend has dedicated forgot-password screen with email input, OTP input, and new password input.

community_tab.details: Community tab visible in bottom navigation (5 tabs total: Home, Community, Transactions, Invest, Profile). Advisor tab hidden as per requirements. Community screen accessible but not fully tested (post creation, likes, comments) due to onboarding persistence issue.

avatar_upload.details: POST /api/auth/avatar endpoint working. Accepts base64 image data. Requires authentication (returns 401 without token). Successfully updates user avatar in MongoDB.

instapay_payment.details: InstaPay payment option visible in subscription screen along with Vodafone Cash and Fawry. Payment methods section displays correctly with icons and labels.
